```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint-and-test-memory-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install ruff pytest uv

      - name: Run linter
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run pytest -v

  lint-and-test-wifi-cam-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install ruff uv

      - name: Run linter
        run: uv run ruff check .

  update-readme-claude:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Update README.md and CLAUDE.md
        run: |
          echo "Updating README.md and CLAUDE.md..."
          # Add your commands to update README.md and CLAUDE.md here
          # For example:
          # sed -i 's/old_text/new_text/g' README.md
          # sed -i 's/old_text/new_text/g' CLAUDE.md

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add README.md CLAUDE.md
          git commit -m "Update README.md and CLAUDE.md"
          git push origin main
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file includes three jobs:

1. `lint-and-test-memory-mcp`: Lints and tests the `memory-mcp` directory using Ruff and Pytest.
2. `lint-and-test-wifi-cam-mcp`: Lints the `wifi-cam-mcp` directory using Ruff.
3. `update-readme-claude`: Updates the `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files as per the specified requirements.

Make sure to replace the placeholder commands in the `update-readme-claude` job with actual commands to update the files accordingly.
